import json, os
from pathlib import Path
sessions = sorted((Path(os.environ['TESS_CORE_HOME']) / 'sessions').glob('*.json'))
record = json.loads(sessions[0].read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
task_ids = record.get('metadata', {}).get('taskIds') or []
print(f'session-task-ids={len(task_ids)}')
